description: Source code implementing the TransformFeedbackVk class for Vulkan backend in ANGLE project, handling transform feedback operations, buffer management, descriptor set updates, and related Vulkan interactions.

classes.name: TransformFeedbackVk
classes.description: Class implementing transform feedback functionality for Vulkan in ANGLE.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Starts transform feedback operation, invalidates current buffers, and resumes transform feedback.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Ends transform feedback, possibly updates active query, and pauses transform feedback.

methods.name: bindIndexedBuffer
methods.description: Binds an indexed buffer for transform feedback, ensuring proper alignment.

methods.name: updateDescriptorSetLayout
methods.description: Updates descriptor set layout based on program state.

methods.name: addFramebufferDependency
methods.description: Adds framebuffer dependency for transform feedback buffers.

methods.name: initDescriptorSet
methods.description: Initializes descriptor set with empty buffers.

methods.name: updateDescriptorSet
methods.description: Updates descriptor set with current buffer ranges.

methods.name: getBufferOffsets
methods.description: Calculates buffer offsets for transform feedback outputs.

methods.name: onBeginOrEnd
methods.description: Handles resource management at start or end of transform feedback.

methods.name: writeDescriptorSet
methods.description: Writes buffer info into Vulkan descriptor set.
